# The PC Secure

> > The PC Secure is a movie streaming portal offering Indonesian-subtitled films across multiple genres through Bioskop21, LK21, Layarkaca21, and Indoxxi platforms.

The site aggregates international cinema from Korea, USA, Japan, India, and other countries, providing streaming access with Indonesian subtitles. Content spans action, drama, thriller, comedy, and adult films from 2015-2023.
